name: Abstract Cauchy-Crofton formula for arbitrary kinematic measures in ℝⁿ

insights: The entire polygonal Cauchy-Crofton formula follows from integral_add by list induction — linearity of expectation is the only tool needed beyond the single-segment axiom
simp_rw (not rw) is required for rewriting under integral binders in MeasureTheory
Step-2 recurrence α_{n+2} = (n/(n+1))·α_n follows from the step-4 recurrence by push_cast; ring for n≥2, and direct norm_num for n=1
Real.pi_lt_3141593 was removed from Mathlib v4.26.0; Real.pi_lt_315 is the correct bound to use (used in several gallery proofs)
Pattern matching in structural recursion requires explicit absurd cases for unreachable branches (| 0, h => absurd h (by omega))
Abstract formulation reveals Buffon 2D/3D are special cases of the same framework; shape independence is purely algebraic
